name: List All Community Association Units
description: Returns all Community Association (CA) units that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[Id]
queryFilters.description: Filter by unique identifier of the CA unit

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter for CA units updated at or after this date. All GET requests must include a filter for [Id] (if available), or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: filters[AssociationId]
queryFilters.description: Filter by unique identifier of the association associated with the unit

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the CA unit

responseFields.name: data[].Name
responseFields.description: The name of the CA unit

responseFields.name: data[].AssociationId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the CA associated with the unit

responseFields.name: data[].CurrentOccupancyId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the current occupancy associated with the CA unit

responseFields.name: data[].CustomFields
responseFields.description: The custom fields for the associated entity

responseFields.name: data[].Address1
responseFields.description: The primary street address of the CA unit

responseFields.name: data[].Address2
responseFields.description: Additional street address information pertaining to the CA unit

responseFields.name: data[].City
responseFields.description: The city where the CA unit is located

responseFields.name: data[].RenterOccupied
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not the CA unit is occupied by a renter

responseFields.name: data[].State
responseFields.description: The state where the CA unit is located

responseFields.name: data[].Zip
responseFields.description: The zip code where the CA unit is located

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The date the CA unit's details were last updated

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
